title: scope add — Zoho Incremental Authorization (Two-Step Browser Flow)
description: Replace the current no-op local-only scope tracking in 'scope add' with the real Zoho incremental authorization two-step flow: (1) POST /oauth/v2/token/scopeenhance to get an enhance_token, (2) browser redirect to GET /oauth/v2/token/addextrascope for user consent, (3) on success, persist the updated scope list and immediately refresh the access token. This change makes 'scope add' actually update the Zoho refresh token rather than only recording scopes locally. Required infrastructure: IAuthProvider.GetScopeEnhancementTokenAsync, LocalCallbackServer.WaitForScopeEnhancedCallbackAsync, two new ErrorCodes, and a --port flag on 'scope add'.
prerequisiteState: Stories 1–14 complete. NeedsReauth is fully removed. AccountService.AddScopesAsync exists but has the old local-only implementation. LocalCallbackServer, IOAuthBrowserFlow, OAuthProvider, IAuthProvider, DcResolver all exist. Project compiles and all tests pass.
goal: After this story: 'zapi-cli scope add --scope ZohoCRM.Contacts.READ' opens a browser to the Zoho incremental auth consent page, waits for the user to approve, then persists the new scope in AccountEntry.Scopes and obtains a fresh access token. The Zoho refresh token is updated server-side with the new scope.
scope: Modify src/ZapiCli.Core/ErrorCodes.cs: Add 'public const string SCOPE_ENHANCE_DENIED = "SCOPE_ENHANCE_DENIED";' (for user rejection or unexpected callback) and 'public const string SCOPE_ENHANCE_FAILED = "SCOPE_ENHANCE_FAILED";' (for HTTP-level failure on POST /scopeenhance). Both are public constants following the existing naming convention.

Modify src/ZapiCli.Core/Auth/IAuthProvider.cs: Add method 'Task<(string EnhanceToken, string ClientId)> GetScopeEnhancementTokenAsync(string accountName, string dc, CancellationToken ct = default);'. XML doc: 'Exchanges the stored refresh token for a short-lived scope enhancement token via POST /oauth/v2/token/scopeenhance (grant_type=update_scopes_token). Returns a tuple of (enhanceToken, clientId). The enhanceToken expires in ~600s and must not be stored. Throws ZapiCliException with SCOPE_ENHANCE_FAILED (exit 2) on HTTP failure or if access_token is missing from the response.'

Modify src/ZapiCli.Core/Auth/OAuthProvider.cs: Implement GetScopeEnhancementTokenAsync — (1) Read keychain JSON via '_keychain.GetAsync(MakeKey(accountName), ct)'; throw KEYCHAIN_ERROR (exit 2) if null. (2) Deserialize to OAuthCredentials using CamelCaseOptions. (3) 'var baseUrl = DcResolver.GetAccountsBaseUrl(dc)'. (4) Build form data: { client_id, client_secret, grant_type='update_scopes_token', refresh_token }. (5) POST to '{baseUrl}/oauth/v2/token/scopeenhance' using _httpClientFactory.CreateClient(). (6) Catch non-cancellation exceptions and wrap in ZapiCliException(SCOPE_ENHANCE_FAILED, exitCode: 2). (7) On non-success HTTP status, throw ZapiCliException with message 'Scope enhancement token request failed (HTTP {status}).', SCOPE_ENHANCE_FAILED, exitCode 2. (8) Parse JSON response — extract 'access_token'; throw SCOPE_ENHANCE_FAILED if missing or empty. (9) Return (access_token, creds.ClientId).

Modify src/ZapiCli.Core/Auth/LocalCallbackServer.cs: Add 'public virtual async Task WaitForScopeEnhancedCallbackAsync(TimeSpan timeout, CancellationToken ct = default)'. Implementation follows the exact same CancellationTokenSource + CancelAfter + GetContextAsync pattern as WaitForCallbackAsync. After getting context: (1) Parse query['error'] — if non-empty, respond with BuildErrorHtml(error) and throw ZapiCliException(error, ErrorCodes.SCOPE_ENHANCE_DENIED, exitCode: 1). (2) Parse query['status'] and query['scope_enhanced'] — if status != 'success' OR scope_enhanced != 'true', respond with BuildErrorHtml('Scope enhancement was not approved.') and throw ZapiCliException('Scope enhancement was not approved.', ErrorCodes.SCOPE_ENHANCE_DENIED, exitCode: 1). (3) Respond with BuildSuccessHtml() and return. LOGIN_TIMEOUT exception format is the same as WaitForCallbackAsync.

Modify src/ZapiCli.Core/Accounts/IAccountService.cs — AddScopesAsync: Add 'int callbackPort = 8085' parameter before 'CancellationToken ct = default'. Update XML doc to describe: the two-step browser consent flow; callbackPort usage ('Register http://localhost:{callbackPort}/callback as a redirect URI in the Zoho Developer Console — this must match exactly'); new error codes SCOPE_ENHANCE_DENIED and SCOPE_ENHANCE_FAILED; ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND still thrown if account is absent.

Modify src/ZapiCli.Core/Accounts/AccountService.cs — replace the entire AddScopesAsync body with the new two-step flow: (1) Load accounts via _accountStore.LoadAsync; find account by name; throw ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND (exit 1) if missing. (2) ZohoCorpGuard.AssertNotZohoCorp(account.Email). (3) Build updatedScopes: start from account.Scopes.ToList(); foreach scopeToAdd, if not already contained (StringComparer.Ordinal), add it. (4) 'var (enhanceToken, clientId) = await _authProvider.GetScopeEnhancementTokenAsync(accountName, account.Dc, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);'. (5) 'await using var server = new LocalCallbackServer(callbackPort);'. (6) 'var redirectUri = $"http://localhost:{server.Port}/callback";'. (7) 'var baseUrl = DcResolver.GetAccountsBaseUrl(account.Dc);'. (8) Build addExtraScopeUrl: '{baseUrl}/oauth/v2/token/addextrascope?client_id={Uri.EscapeDataString(clientId)}&response_type=update_scopes&redirect_uri={Uri.EscapeDataString(redirectUri)}&scope={Uri.EscapeDataString(string.Join(",", scopesToAdd))}&enhance_token={Uri.EscapeDataString(enhanceToken)}&logout=true'. (9) 'Console.Error.WriteLine($"Redirect URI (must be registered in Zoho Developer Console): {redirectUri}");'. (10) '_browserFlow.OpenBrowser(addExtraScopeUrl);'. (11) 'Console.Error.WriteLine("Waiting for browser scope consent... (timeout: 120s)");'. (12) 'await server.WaitForScopeEnhancedCallbackAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(120), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);'. (13) Persist: 'var updatedAccount = account with { Scopes = updatedScopes };'; build updatedAccounts list replacing old entry; 'await _accountStore.SaveAsync(new AccountsRoot { Accounts = updatedAccounts }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);'. (14) 'await _authProvider.RefreshTokenAsync(accountName, updatedScopes, account.Dc, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);'. (15) Return (updatedAccount.Name, updatedScopes).

Modify src/ZapiCli/Commands/ScopeCommands.cs — ScopeAddSettings: Add '[CommandOption("--port <PORT>")] public int Port { get; init; } = 8085;' with XML doc 'Local port for the OAuth callback server. Must register http://localhost:{PORT}/callback as a redirect URI in the Zoho Developer Console.'

Modify src/ZapiCli/Commands/ScopeCommands.cs — ScopeAddCommand.ExecuteAsync: Update the AddScopesAsync call to pass settings.Port as callbackPort: 'await _accountService.AddScopesAsync(accountName, incoming, settings.Port).ConfigureAwait(false)'.

Unit tests in tests/ZapiCli.Tests/Scopes/ScopeAddIncrementalAuthTests.cs (new file): Test 1 — GetScopeEnhancementTokenAsync success: FakeHttpMessageHandler returns '{ "access_token": "enhance-tok" }' for /scopeenhance POST; assert return value is ('enhance-tok', clientId). Test 2 — GetScopeEnhancementTokenAsync HTTP failure: handler returns 400; assert ZapiCliException with SCOPE_ENHANCE_FAILED. Test 3 — GetScopeEnhancementTokenAsync missing access_token: handler returns '{}'; assert ZapiCliException with SCOPE_ENHANCE_FAILED. Test 4 — WaitForScopeEnhancedCallbackAsync success: test subclass of LocalCallbackServer returns query '?status=success&scope_enhanced=true'; assert no exception thrown. Test 5 — WaitForScopeEnhancedCallbackAsync error callback: returns '?error=access_denied'; assert ZapiCliException with SCOPE_ENHANCE_DENIED. Test 6 — AddScopesAsync end-to-end (AccountService integration test): inject FakeAuthProvider (returns preset enhanceToken+clientId from GetScopeEnhancementTokenAsync, records RefreshTokenAsync calls), inject fake LocalCallbackServer factory returning a preset success; call AddScopesAsync with new scope; assert (a) accounts.json saved with merged scope list, (b) RefreshTokenAsync called with updatedScopes.
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build src/zapi-cli.sln succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings
ErrorCodes.SCOPE_ENHANCE_DENIED and ErrorCodes.SCOPE_ENHANCE_FAILED exist as public const strings
IAuthProvider.GetScopeEnhancementTokenAsync is declared with return type Task<(string EnhanceToken, string ClientId)>
LocalCallbackServer.WaitForScopeEnhancedCallbackAsync parses status + scope_enhanced query params and throws SCOPE_ENHANCE_DENIED on rejection
AccountService.AddScopesAsync calls GetScopeEnhancementTokenAsync, opens browser to /addextrascope URL, awaits WaitForScopeEnhancedCallbackAsync, persists updated scopes, and calls RefreshTokenAsync
enhance_token is never stored to disk or keychain — it is used only inline to build the addextrascope URL
contextForAgent: Read src/ZapiCli.Core/Auth/OAuthProvider.cs in full before adding GetScopeEnhancementTokenAsync — the method structure mirrors RefreshTokenAsync: same keychain read, same DcResolver call, similar HTTP post pattern, same JSON parsing style using JsonDocument. The endpoint differs (/scopeenhance vs /token) and the grant_type differs (update_scopes_token vs refresh_token). Read src/ZapiCli.Core/Auth/LocalCallbackServer.cs in full — WaitForScopeEnhancedCallbackAsync reuses BuildErrorHtml and BuildSuccessHtml private helpers; the only difference from WaitForCallbackAsync is the response parsing (status+scope_enhanced vs code+state). Read src/ZapiCli.Core/Accounts/AccountService.cs — AddScopesAsync currently has a short body (load, dedup, save, set NeedsReauth=true); the new body replaces it entirely, but the dedup logic (lines 3 of the old body) is preserved unchanged. For the LocalCallbackServer factory injection pattern in AccountService unit tests: AccountService.AddScopesAsync calls 'new LocalCallbackServer(callbackPort)' directly; to test without binding a port, use the same serverFactory Func<LocalCallbackServer> pattern established in LoginAsync — add an overload or internal parameter. For FakeAuthProvider: create or extend the existing fake to implement GetScopeEnhancementTokenAsync returning preset values and recording calls.

openItems.item: LocalCallbackServer factory injection in AddScopesAsync for testability
openItems.defaultAssumption: Add an internal overload of AddScopesAsync that accepts a Func<int, LocalCallbackServer> serverFactory parameter (default: port => new LocalCallbackServer(port)), mirroring the pattern used in LoginAsync. Production code uses the default; tests inject a fake server that returns preset consent results without binding an HttpListener.
